name: hcfmailer-plus
description: Self-hosted email newsletter application based on Mailtrain

scripts.dev: concurrently -n infra,client,server -c cyan,green,yellow "bun run dev:infra" "bun run dev:client" "bun run dev:server"
scripts.dev:infra: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && docker compose -f docker-compose-develop.yml up
scripts.dev:client: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && bun run --filter ./client dev
scripts.dev:server: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && bun run --filter ./server dev
scripts.dev:preview: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && bun run build && VITE_PREVIEW=true bun run --filter ./server dev
scripts.dev:zone-mta: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && bun run --filter ./zone-mta start
scripts.dev:restore:s3: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && bunx tsx scripts/dev-restore-s3.ts
scripts.install:all:deep: find . -name 'node_modules' | xargs rm -rf && bun run install:all && bun run build
